Select: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id; activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid; activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter: activities.type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1628461' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
Limit: 1000
sql: SELECT a_s.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays a_s ON a.assay_id = a_s.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a_s.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1628461' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a_s.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
